KVIKDOS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install kvikdos. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

KVIKDOS_VERSION.description: Specific version of kvikdos to install.

KVIKDOS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading kvikdos binary or archive artifacts.

KVIKDOS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying kvikdos available remote releases.

KVIKDOS_BACKEND.description: Execution backend selection: auto, vm8086 (delegating to win-cmd-asm), or c89-emu (portable zero-dependency 8086 CPU + INT 21h emulator).

KVIKDOS_MAX_STEPS.description: Maximum 8086 instruction budget before aborting a runaway 16-bit tool invocation.

KVIKDOS_MEM_KB.description: Conventional RAM size in KiB exposed to guest 16-bit DOS build utilities.
